Kuonji R. Spica is the daughter of an UFS agent and Taimanin.

Once again, I have cut a worthless foe...Am I doing this right?
Kuonji R. Spica



Personality
Spica has a bright personality and loves samurai and historical TV series. She's very easy-going, outspoken and cheerful, without caring too much for proper protocol but timid when it comes to dealing with relationship issues. At times, mimics the speech and mannerisms of a Sengoku-era samurai because she loves watching period dramas on TV.

However, on missions and when fighting against demons or Nomad, she displays reckless abandon and rage. Driven by her fanaticism, which she adopted from her captors in an almost Stockholm Syndrome like way. She becomes very hard to work with at this point and rushes ahead or goes for the killing option more than is needed.

She had displayed trouble working with people like Lydia Baretta.

Appearance
She has blond hair and blue eyes.

History
Background
Taimanin member of a special UFS institute.

Born to a Taimanin who became a UFS member, and a UFS agent. Kuonji Lost her parents to demons and was pretty much captured/adopted by an extreme UFS anti-demon research facility. To avenge her parent's deaths, she was part of the research but neglected her combat skills at first. Part of the program was human experimentation, meant to give other children, her Taima Particles but this resulted in failure with only normal humans as a result.

Over the years Spica grew into an anti demon fanatic and is as part of a special UFS institute, she was deployed as a UFS inspector to watch the Taimanin Task Force.

Timeline Action
When Nomad, struggled with internal and external struggles of local mafias, after the large data leak from Momochi Toyo. Fürst and Oboro planned to use each other for credit on the matter, to make things more stable. A bit of stolen UFS tech made their way through the streets, meant for Task Force G. Spica was part of a joined operation of a number of UFS Taimanin and Gosha. However, as soon as she spotted Oboro, lost her cool and hunted her and any other Nomad she saw down.

In the end, only a small part of the data could be recovered, with the mission considered a failure. Oboro herself was given the credit, and she rose up even further in Nomad, much to the annoyance of Fürst. In another event, while being pulled from a mission and put on standby, Spica ignored her waiting orders and went on a small shopping trip and by chance ran into jewelry thieves, which took Spinel hostage in the heat of the moment. While, Spica clumsily handled the situation, even hitting Spinels horn with one of her bullets ricocheting. Spinel became bored and broke free on her own, and the group united with Shinganji Kurenai and Makishima Ayame, which were in the area, to hunt down and defeat the thief group.

In another event much later. Spica greeted Mirabell Bell and the Stormcats at Kinki International Airport, where they had arrived a month early for joint training and some vacation time. However, their visit quickly turned chaotic. Just as they were about to leave, the airport was targeted in a terror attack. Spica and Mirabell’s team helped save civilians while keeping a low profile to avoid drawing attention as outsiders. After the attack, Spica took them to a hotel in Amidahara for the night. The next morning, they were thrust into a violent confrontation with a mafia group connected to the Chinese Union. Forced to flee before the situation escalated further, they left significant damage to the mafia’s vehicles in their escape. The group continued their journey to Maesaki City, but a stray bullet hit one of their vehicles, forcing them to search for fuel. Along the way, they encountered more thugs linked to the same mafia, resulting in another battle. Though they defeated the group, their vehicles were set on fire, and they had to walk the rest of the way. By the time they reached Maesaki City, it was late, and Hasuba Reiko was waiting for them. Initially frustrated, she quickly understood the situation when she saw the exhausted but still composed group. Mirabell explained the chaos, and despite the rough journey, they finally rested.


Powers/Abilities
Main Weapon: Uses a Japanese sword and pistol

Ninja Art: "Water Art", "Bubble Art". She makes bubbles out of moisture in the air, forcing enemies to slip on them or enhances weapons by covering them with her bubbles.
Particle Control: Taimanin are able to manipulate Taima Particles to enhance their physical strength, speed and defense. The particles are also used to counter demonic influences and strengthen damage to demons.

She has joined with DSO operations, but the faction seems to be too extreme even for the DSO.
